name: Variform-Q9
description: Variform-Q9 is Apex Nanofabrication's flagship programmable matter substrate — a dense suspension of quantum-locked nano-actuator units held in a coherent lattice by a continuous low-power EM field, allowing the bulk material to flow, solidify, and reconfigure into arbitrary shapes on command via encrypted neural or digital instruction. Each cubic centimeter contains approximately 40 billion individual actuator nodes capable of independent positioning, giving the material sub-millimeter shape resolution. The coherence field requires a continuous power draw of 8W per kilogram, and loss of power causes the material to collapse into an amorphous semi-solid until power is restored.
applications: Elite-level adaptive furniture and architectural interiors
Surgical tool systems that reconfigure during procedures
High-value security barriers with remote-reshape capability
Custom prosthetics for complex anatomical needs
Spire-level personal accessories and display objects
cost: Φ 18,000 per kg (coherence field emitter: Φ 4,200 per unit)
story_hooks: A Variform-Q9 security barrier in a Spire facility has been slaved to a hacked instruction set — someone can reshape it remotely, turning the building's own defenses into a labyrinth that traps the people inside.

A quantity of Variform-Q9 has gone missing from an Apex Nanofabrication shipment; without the coherence emitter it's inert slurry, but whoever stole it clearly has the emitter too — and the material can become anything.

A dying Spire-level executive has their estate's Variform-Q9 interior locked to a biometric key that only responds to them, and their heirs are hiring anyone who can crack the configuration before the will contest goes to court.
